# udoma_catalog_group_subscription (Resource)

Resource represents a catalog group subscription



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `code` (String) Code of the catalog group being subscribed to.

### Optional

- `exclude_list` (List of String) Catalog item codes to exclude from the group subscription.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) The date and time the subscription was created.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the catalog group subscription.
- `updated_at` (Number) The date and time the subscription was last updated.
